scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Parse once and retain rejection evidence
cases.input_contract: Parse raw with the explicit payload schema and PERMISSIVE mode, then add reason using precedence missing_payload, malformed_json, missing_parent, accepted. Preserve source_id and raw.
cases.expected: Sources 1-4 accepted;5 malformed_json;6 missing_parent;7 missing_payload. No source disappears and accepted count is 4.
cases.verification: Assert all seven ordered source/reason rows and reconcile accepted 4 plus rejected 3 with input 7.

cases.title: Record collection state before changing grain
cases.input_contract: For accepted records return source_id, parent_id, items, array_state, with array_state unknown, empty or populated. Keep arrays typed and preserve the two repeated SKU occurrences.
cases.expected: Parent 10 populated,20 empty,30 unknown,40 populated. Parent 10 has size 2;parent 40 size 1.
cases.verification: Assert the four parent/state rows and item lengths independently of any later explode output.

cases.title: Flatten observed child occurrences
cases.input_contract: Use posexplode to return parent_id, position, sku, qty for actual items. Order by parent_id and position, and retain repeated SKU a.
cases.expected: Rows(10,0, a,2),(10,1, a,3),(40,0, b, NULL). Exactly 3 children;parents 20 and 30 produce none.
cases.verification: Assert the entire three-row occurrence list and unique(parent_id, position) count 3.

cases.title: Preserve parents without inventing observed children
cases.input_contract: Use posexplode_outer, preserving parent_id and array_state along with position, sku, qty. Keep null placeholders for empty and unknown arrays.
cases.expected: Five rows:the three observed children plus(20, empty, NULL, NULL, NULL) and (30, unknown, NULL, NULL, NULL).
cases.verification: Assert five rows, four distinct parents and exactly three nonnull generated positions.

cases.title: Reconcile child counts and nullable measures
cases.input_contract: Aggregate the outer relation to parent_id, array_state, child_count, known_qty_count, total_qty. Count positions for children and preserve SUM NULL when there are no known quantities.
cases.expected: Parent 10:(2,2,5);20:(0,0, NULL);30:(0,0, NULL);40:(1,0, NULL). Empty and unknown collection states remain visible.
cases.verification: Assert each parent count tuple and that summed child_count is 3 while known_qty_count is 2.

cases.title: Choose Cartesian or positional array semantics
cases.input_contract: For one parent with SKUs[a, b] and channels[web, shop, api], return both independent exploded pairs and arrays_zip positional rows. Explain the relationship required for each interpretation.
cases.expected: Independent generators produce 6 pairs;zip produces(a, web),(b, shop),(NULL, api), three rows.
cases.verification: Assert the complete Cartesian pair set and all three ordered zipped rows including the paddedNULL.
